meta.title: Brazil Premium / Pay-TV-like - Working (tested)
preferences_matched: premium / pay-TV style: movies, series, sports, news, kids
meta.test_method: HTTP GET master playlist, check 200 + #EXTM3U + RESOLUTION. Tested 2026-09-20.
meta.tokens_note: No manual token extraction needed for this file - all URLs below returned 200 without custom headers. FAST entries (jmp2.uk / Pluto / Samsung TV Plus) already embed a rotating authToken query string maintained by the proxy; just use as-is. True premium (Premiere, Telecine, HBO Max linear, SporTV 1/2 official, ESPN official app, Combate) use login + DRM Widevine + IP-bound short-lived tokens (minutes) and have no stable open HLS - not included because they fail without subscription. Do not hardcode tokens you find in devtools - they expire.
meta.player_notes: mpv / VLC / TiviMate / Kodi. All HLS. No MPEG-DASH stable in this sweep.
